items.html: And indeed, remember and do not forget, that the four worlds ABYA were made from two discernments: one is the old light, called the world of Nekudim, which are the aspect of the aforementioned seven kings; the second discernment is the new light, called the HaVaYaH of MA of the Alef's, which came out from the illumination of the upper forehead of AK. And these two discernments are the males and females in all the four worlds ABYA.
